product.untitled.note: the name of a product until someone names it

product.slugInvalid: Use lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens in the address, up to 80 characters.
product.slugTaken: {path} is used by another product, now or before. Pick another address.
product.shortLong: Keep the short description to 120 characters: it's what the shop's cards show.
product.priceMinimum: The price must be at least $1.
product.pwywMinimum: The minimum must be at least $1.
product.suggestedBelow: The suggested price can't be below the minimum.
product.priceKind: Choose One-time or Pay what you want.
product.coverURL: Upload the cover, or use an https:// address.
product.pageGone: That page doesn't exist any more. Pick another sales page, or the default product page.
product.listGone: That list doesn't exist any more. Pick another list for the offer.
product.offerIncomplete: Pick the list buyers join and write the offer's exact text, or turn the list offer off.
product.templateGone: That template doesn't exist any more. Pick the delivery template again.
product.checksFailed: Fix the publish checks first: they list what's missing.
product.priceChangeConfirm: Publishing changes the price. Confirm it: existing buyers keep their access and nobody is charged again.
product.stripeMissing: Connect Stripe in Earn › Settings › Payments before publishing: nothing can be bought without it.
product.stripeRejected: Stripe refused the key. Replace it in Earn › Settings › Payments, then publish again.
product.stripePermission: The Stripe key can't create products and prices. Give it those permissions in Stripe, then publish again.
product.stripeUnavailable: Stripe didn't answer. Nothing was published; try again in a minute.
product.archiveDraft: Only a published product can be archived. Delete the draft instead.
product.deletePublished: A product that was published can't be deleted, because its buyers keep their downloads. Archive it instead.
product.slugExhausted: Every address like this one is taken. Pick another.
cover.interrupted: The upload was interrupted. Try again.
file.tooBig: That file is {size}. Files can be up to 500 MB each.
file.productFull: That would make the product's files {size}, over the 2 GB a product can hold. Remove a file first.
file.program: That file is a program. Programs can't be sold or offered as downloads.
file.mismatch: This file says .{ext} but contains {content}. Buyers would get a file their computer can't open. Upload the {claimed} itself, or the {actual} with a .{actualExt} name.
file.uploadGone: That upload stopped and nothing was kept. Choose the file again.
file.offset: Part of the upload arrived twice. It continues from {offset} bytes.
file.incomplete: The upload isn't finished: {have} of {size} bytes arrived.
file.notFound: That file isn't part of the product any more.

leadMagnet.days.note: a signup form's download: how long its links work

route.withFallback.note: the Transactional route that sends delivery emails: Postmark, then Amazon SES

order.revoked: Access to this order's download is revoked. Restore it first.
order.alreadyRevoked: Access to this order's download is revoked already.
order.refundedNoRestore: This order was refunded in full, so its download stays revoked.
order.test: Test orders never move money. Use Stripe's test dashboard to refund them.
order.exportPeople: Exporting orders needs subscribers:export, because orders hold buyers' addresses.
notify.deliveryFailedBody: The delivery email of order {order} ({product}) to {email} wasn't sent: {reason}. The buyer has the download on the thank-you page; send a new link once it's fixed.
notify.disputeBody: {email} disputed order {order} ({product}, {amount}) as “{reason}”. Respond in Stripe by {due}.
notify.disputeBodyNoDue: {email} disputed order {order} ({product}, {amount}) as “{reason}”. Respond in Stripe.
notify.disputeRevoked: Access to the download was revoked, as the product says.
checkout.archived: This product isn't for sale any more.
checkout.unavailable: Not available until Stripe is connected.
checkout.pwywBelow: The amount must be at least {minimum}.
checkout.failed: Stripe didn't answer, so checkout couldn't start. No payment was taken; try again in a minute.

activity.bought.note: a contact's timeline: what they paid for a product, and the order's number

activity.refunded.note: a contact's timeline: a refund of a product order
